(i) information activities are growing in all segments of US economy; (ii) energy use is growing at a slower rate than information activities; (iii) the contribution of information in energy savings is significant; and (iv) the contribution of energy in information production is not significant.
information activities have been expanding in all economic sectors in the US economy and they are saving energy.
information activities are increasing in all sectors of the economy and that they are saving energy.

the role of information as a potential source of energy savings.
the role of information as an economic input, and its contribution to the reduction of energy use in the US economy.
the role that information plays in the economy.

the US economy has become increasingly information-based, and the energy intensity of the information activities is lower than the economy's energy intensity.
information activities have the potential to reduce the energy intensity of the economy, and that this potential has been realized in the US economy.
information is a major force behind the energy savings of the US economy.

, in the US economy, information activities are growing rapidly, and they are contributing to energy savings.
information activities are not only an integral part of economic activity but also a major factor in energy savings.
the information economy is a more efficient energy economy.

information activities in the US economy have been growing rapidly and that these activities are substituting for energy in many sectors.
